title: Extended-Use Sanitation Labor by Days Kept — PAP Therapy Equipment Returns
content:
# Extended-Use Sanitation Labor — PAP Therapy Equipment Returns

**Schedule.** On the return inspection of a self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit that has come back to Summit Ridge on a completed return pickup request, the labor booked for the unit includes sanitation for the time the patient kept it:

- a unit kept **more than 14 days** adds **2 labor units** for extended-use sanitation;
- a unit kept **more than 7 and up to 14 days** adds **1 labor unit**;
- a unit kept **7 days or less** adds none.

**Days kept.** The days are counted from the delivery date on the device record to the date the completed return pickup request records the unit as received back — the decision date of that completed request. They are the number of calendar days from the one date to the other, the delivery date itself not counted: a unit received back the day after delivery was kept 1 day. Labor units are 15-minute units.

## Both sides of each line

| Days kept | Labor units added |
|---|---|
| 7 | 0 |
| 8 | 1 |
| 14 | 1 |
| 15 | 2 |
| 40 | 2 |

## Cases (hypothetical dates)

- Delivered 2 May, completed return pickup request decided 9 May: 7 days kept, nothing added.
- Delivered 2 May, received back 16 May: 14 days kept, 1 labor unit added.
- Delivered 2 May, received back 17 May: 15 days kept, 2 labor units added.
